title: s500-generic-44: Crossmodal face-name person-identity frequency tagging, SEEG of the left ventral temporal cortex (Volfart et al., 2020) (derivative)
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from the left ventral temporal cortex of three epilepsy patients with usable data, collected during a crossmodal frequency-tagging paradigm. Faces and written names of a famous identity were presented at 4 Hz, with a different identity inserted every 7th item (0.571 Hz). Face-only and name-only control conditions were also included. This is a derivative of the authors' Letswave-processed files: 30 Hz low-pass filtered and cut into sequences, repackaged in BIDS.
methods_description: SEEG was recorded from patients with refractory epilepsy at the University Hospital of Nancy during fast periodic visual stimulation of faces and names. The authors imported the Micromed recordings into Letswave 5, applied a 4th-order Butterworth low-pass filter at 30 Hz, and cut sequences from 2 s after onset to about 61 s. Sequences from each condition were merged and then repackaged in BrainVision format with Talairach electrode coordinates.
